intent: Make the existing reasoning explicit in the teacher's speech style. No new examples, methods, questions, or answers.
implementation: 317 existing paragraphs have spoken context added. Every original plain paragraph remains verbatim within its revised version. No slide or paragraph has been inserted, deleted, or reordered.
fonts_and_recording_controls: HTML outside const DATA is byte-for-byte unchanged.
sources: Each _ai_vis_t13.py through _ai_vis_t18.py applies _codex_script_clarity_20261012.py after its original visual passes. The adjacent JSON is the reviewed spoken-only overlay. ai_scripts, Reading Studio, ai_json, studio_slides, and rebuild therefore use the same text.
visuals: All 6492 timing anchors keep their exact original phrases and their original positions within the original speech. Additions do not shadow those phrases. All graphics, targets, cue order, and handwriting plans remain unchanged.
recording: Use the existing full-read/re-read workflow. Paragraph indices are unchanged. Added sentences require new teacher audio; no existing WAV, take sidecar, MP4, or audio timing manifest has been edited. Previously exported videos remain their earlier versions.
future_edits: If editing an original narrated paragraph in a topic source, reconcile that paragraph's original/revised pair in the overlay. A mismatch raises an error rather than silently restoring stale wording. Do not remove the hooks or regenerate scripts without this overlay.

followup_speaking_audit_2026_10_12.request: Correct number-display errors and title-like spoken fragments; do not change recorded lessons.

These only replace phrase anchors to match edited speech; targets, actions, graphics and indices stay unchanged. ai_scripts were updated to agree with the hooked topic sources.
followup_speaking_audit_2026_10_12.display: reading_studio.math_display now separates counts from hyphenated digit adjectives; recognizes spoken hundreds shorthand and fractional denominators; brackets negative/fractional power bases. No spoken number, recording sidecar, WAV, video or media timing was modified.
followup_speaking_audit_2026_10_12.recorded_display_exception: Only the reported q-430 display typo was corrected from 63-digit to 60 three-digit. q-430 spoken text, including Michal, remains unchanged because it has a recording.

current_visuals: Original board plans, cue actions, targets, fonts and layout are preserved. The speaking audit retargeted 12 phrase anchors in unrecorded lessons to match their natural-spoken transitions; see followup_speaking_audit_2026_10_12.

adaptive_counterexample_audit_20261012.scope: All 115 current studio lessons audited; affected paragraphs changed only.
adaptive_counterexample_audit_20261012.provenance: Three-tests-before-options in lesson 74 was already in the original source. Earlier Codex narration rewrite retained it.
adaptive_counterexample_audit_20261012.rule: Start with easy numbers fitting the givens, not a hindsight-selected magic example. No advance knowledge of how many options it will eliminate is required. Check options after each example. Another easy example only if needed; explain the different feature being tested and stop at one remaining option. Do not infer universal truth from a fixed number of samples.
adaptive_counterexample_audit_20261012.overlapping_choices: 70/73 have overlapping most-precise descriptions. Do not falsely eliminate a broader description with an example it also allows; use the existing general rule.
adaptive_counterexample_audit_20261012.recorded_policy: Audio and sidecars untouched. Existing reread mode detects targeted replacement paragraphs at unchanged indices. Use patches instead of rerecording full lessons.
adaptive_counterexample_audit_20261012.render_policy: After patch takes exist, replace superseded original paragraph audio. Regenerate visuals from approved reviewed_cues. Remove obsolete numerical tests; keep existing styles/fonts. No final videos edited by this script audit.
adaptive_counterexample_audit_20261012.overlay_extension: Approved entries use original_cues/reviewed_cues; helper validates raw-or-reviewed state and is idempotent. Other overlays remain text/anchor only.
